hooks.name: Commit after task completion
hooks.description: Automatically commits changes after each spec task is completed using conventional commit format

action.prompt: After completing this task, you MUST stage all modified files related to the task and create a git commit using conventional commit format (e.g., feat:, fix:, test:, refactor:, chore:, docs:). Choose the appropriate prefix based on the nature of the changes. Keep the commit message concise and descriptive. Do NOT skip this step.
